gloss: to set up; to prepare; to adopt a stance

definitions.explanation: To establish or set up a place such as a home, shop, or office.

definitions.gloss: to adopt a stance; to prepare oneself
definitions.explanation: To take a physical or mental posture in preparation for something.

examples.japanese: {斜|はす}に{構|かま}えた{態度|たいど}はよくない。
examples.english: A cynical attitude is not good.
examples.notes: 「{斜|はす}に{構|かま}える」 means to take a cynical or aloof stance.

notes:
{構|かま}える is a transitive verb.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pair: {構|かま}う (intransitive, though {構|かま}う has different meanings)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {店|みせ}を{構|かま}える (set up a shop)
- {家|いえ}を{構|かま}える (establish a home)
- {刀|かたな}を{構|かま}える (ready one's sword)
- {斜|はす}に{構|かま}える (take a cynical stance)

ASPECT (ている):
- {構|かま}えている can indicate either an ongoing state of readiness or an established setup.
